exposure: vaginal birth after a previous CS for fetal distress and failure to progress
cohort: 152 maternity care professionals in two urban maternity hospitals in Ireland
finding: While most clinicians perceived the CS rate as high and considered birth a natural process, there was a discrepancy between acknowledging elective CS as not the safest option and believing women should have the choice.
mod_finding: This study investigated clinician attitudes towards cesarean section but did not directly examine outcomes associated with different modes of delivery.
